suppress.notes: False positive, reviewed by Claude on 2026-11-03. The CVE is an SMTP injection in Angus Mail before 2.0.4. This jar is Angus Activation, matched only by its version; the app's angus-mail is 2.0.5.

False positive, reviewed by Claude on 2026-11-03. The CVE is in the Prometheus server's remote read endpoint. This jar is Micrometer's client library, and the app does not contain the Prometheus server.

False positive, reviewed by Claude on 2026-11-03. The CVE is in Liquibase before 4.8.0. These jars are Spring Boot's Liquibase integration and starter, matched by their own version 4.1.2; the app's liquibase-core is 5.0.4.
